subject: English
question_text: Read the following sentences and put them in correct order.
stimulus: (a) She had exhausted all her pocket money once in buying some gifts. (b) But she had no money left. (c) Queen Victoria was taught economical habits when she was a girl. (d) She was not permitted to exceed it. (e) She thought it would be just the very thing for him. (f) Suddenly she remembered she should but gift for another cousin. (g) She had a set allowance for pocket money. (h) She saw a box marked half crown.
guide_solution: c → g → d → a → f → h → e → b
